summary_md: **DigitalBayy ([@DigitalBayy](https://x.com/DigitalBayy/status/2116183090246680758))** summarizes Balestriero and LeCun's *Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs* ([arXiv 2610.39302](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39302)): a 109M text-only JEPA aligned with DINOv2 image embeddings better than every LLM tested up to Qwen2.5-72B, while next-token training needed 42× more samples.

referenced_urls.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
